name: Ergothioneine
summary: Ergothioneine is a diet-derived sulfur-containing compound that is actively accumulated in human tissues through the SLC22A4/OCTN1 transporter. Human supplementation evidence for cognition is emerging: a very small one-year mild-cognitive-impairment pilot reported favorable signals, while a larger 16-week trial in older adults with subjective memory complaints did not show a sustained improvement in its primary composite-memory outcome. This profile remains research-only pending replication and broader safety review.
description: Canonical ergothioneine research entity for evidence integration. Publication remains held while the site separates observational and mechanistic interest from randomized human outcomes and reviews dose, duration, sponsor, population, and safety boundaries.
primary_effects_or_targets: SLC22A4/OCTN1 transport; cellular redox defense; neurocognitive-aging research
